title: JEERE fiche boutique, version 1
description: The store config ('fiche boutique') that the JEERE assistant fills, the editor edits and the templates render. Source of truth for ids, labels and limits: data.js (window.JEERE_DATA). One fiche renders the whole store: the home page (the sections below), the product page, the cart, the checkout and the confirmation (JEERE_DATA.PAGES), plus the store's own custom pages (pages: À propos, Livraison et retours, Contact, Conditions de vente...); nothing else in it is specific to a page. This schema checks structure, enums, ranges and the editor's character limits. Quality rules (empty store name, no payment method, fewer than 3 products, missing WhatsApp number, empty page title...) are checked by JEERE_DATA.validate(), not here. Unique section, product and page ids and unique page slugs cannot be expressed in JSON Schema: code checks them (normalizeConfig fixes them; validate() warns about a duplicate slug).

sections.description: Ordered list of page sections. The header and the footer are always rendered and are not sections. Ids 's1', 's2'... must be unique (checked by code).

products.description: The catalogue, in display order. Ids 'p1', 'p2'... must be unique (checked by code).

pages.description: The store's custom pages, in order (the dashboard's « Pages »). A fiche saved before pages existed has no such key: normalizeConfig adds the 4 default pages of its niche (À propos, Livraison et retours, Contact, Conditions de vente); an empty list is kept. Ids 'pg1', 'pg2'... and slugs must be unique (checked by code).

nicheId.description: fashion: Mode et vêtements · hair: Perruques et mèches · beauty: Beauté et soins · jewellery: Bijoux et accessoires · shoes: Chaussures et sneakers · food: Alimentation et traiteur · home: Maison et déco · crafts: Artisanat.

paletteId.description: Sable, Karité, Lagune, Hibiscus, Indigo, Mangue, Menthe, Nuit. The colours themselves live in data.js (contrast-checked); a fiche only names the palette.

intensity.description: Colour intensity (« Couleurs » in the editor's Thème tab): 'vivid' (Vives: the palette's accent carries the page: announcement bar, hero, tinted section backgrounds, solid buttons) or 'soft' (Douces: light backgrounds, the colour in touches). The palette stays the same; the renderer sets [data-intensity] on the store root. Default and recommended: 'vivid'. normalizeConfig reads a fiche saved without it (or with an unknown value) as 'vivid'; validate() reports an unknown value as an error.

fontPairId.description: Éditorial (Playfair + Inter), Moderne (Montserrat + Inter), Doux (Onest), Audacieux (Unbounded + Inter), Classique (EB Garamond + Fira Sans), Simple (Poppins).

artKind.description: Built-in product illustration used when there is neither a photo (image) nor a demo photo (photo). French labels in JEERE_DATA.ART_LABELS.

image.description: null, or a photo uploaded by the seller as a base64 data URL (the editor downsizes it to a JPEG at most 800 px wide). The assistant never sets images. The seller's image always wins over the demo photo (photo).

photo.description: Optional. null, or the id of a Jeere demo photo (JEERE_DATA.DEMO_PHOTOS: a real photo hosted with the app in creer/img/demo/). Set by Jeere from the niche (defaultConfig), never by the assistant, which keeps the value it finds. Shown while there is no image; without either, the illustration shows. normalizeConfig turns an id the catalogue does not know into null; validate() never reports a missing photo.

fcfa.description: Whole amount in FCFA, no separator and no currency (6500, not '6 500 FCFA'). Code formats it for display: 6 500 FCFA.

name.description: Store name, shown as the text logo. validate() reports an error when it is empty.

whatsapp.description: '' or an international number such as +2250707123456 (code normalises it: digits only, +225 added when there is no prefix, leading 0 kept). validate() warns unless it matches ^\+\d{8,15}$.

niche.description: What the store sells, or null.

radius.description: Droit (0 px), Doux (10 px), Rond (22 px).

buttons.description: Plein (accent background) or Contour (1.5 px accent border).

payments.description: Payment methods the store accepts, shown as plain text (never the operators' logos or colours): in the footer, on the product page and as the payment options of the checkout page, in this order. Labels and checkout hints in JEERE_DATA.PAYMENTS. validate() reports an error when none is true.

name.description: validate() reports an error when it is empty.

category.description: Free text. The Catégories section builds its tiles from the distinct non-empty categories, in order of first appearance.

description.description: One or two sentences: material, size, use.

page.description: A custom page, rendered by JeereRender.render(config, root, { page: 'page', pageId }) in the template's style, with the header and the footer; the page whose slug is 'contact' also shows a WhatsApp contact block. validate() reports an error for an empty title, a warning for a duplicate slug and a tip for an empty body.

title.description: The page title, also the link text in the menu and the footer. validate() reports an error when it is empty.

slug.description: The page's address: JEERE_DATA.slugify(title) by default ('livraison-et-retours'), lower case, no accent, words joined by hyphens. Unique in the fiche.

body.description: Plain text, no HTML and no Markdown: paragraphs separated by a blank line. The renderer escapes it.

inMenu.description: Linked in the header: the desktop menu (after the section links, 5 links at most in all) and the phone menu.

inFooter.description: Linked in the footer's pages column.

type.description: announcement (Bandeau d’annonce), hero (Grande bannière), categories (Catégories), products (Produits), about (À propos), reviews (Avis clients), delivery (Livraison), whatsapp (Commander sur WhatsApp).

enabled.description: false hides the section without losing its settings.

settings_announcement.description: Bandeau d’annonce: one short sentence at the very top.

settings_hero.description: Grande bannière. Without an image or a demo photo, the template draws a composition from the first product's photo or illustration.

settings_categories.description: Catégories: the tiles come from the products' categories; only the title is set here.

settings_products.description: Produits: the grid. Phone always shows 2 columns.

columns.description: Columns on desktop (a number, not a string).

settings_about.description: À propos: the seller's story. Without an image or a demo photo, the template draws the first products.

settings_reviews.description: Avis clients. validate() warns when the section is shown with fewer than 2 reviews.

name.description: First name and commune, e.g. 'Mariam, Cocody'.

settings_delivery.description: Livraison: zones (communes) and their fees. The zones of the first enabled delivery section are also the commune list of the checkout page and the delivery line of the product page (JEERE_DATA.communes when there is none). validate() warns when the section is shown with no zone.

fee.description: Delivery fee in whole FCFA (1500, not '1 500 FCFA').

settings_whatsapp.description: Commander sur WhatsApp: the call to action. The button opens the store's WhatsApp number.
